messages:
nico: Quick idea 
Block party LAN this Sunday? Bring controllers you dont use and we can do a swap-meet plus a Smash gauntlet. Casual, drop-in.

anya: Love this. I have an extra DualShock 4 and a weird Dreamcast VMU if anyones nostalgic. :heart: 

derek: I can bring wireless adapters for 360/One pads and 2 USB-C extension cables. Also will bribe people with donuts.

marcos: Would love to try that weird VMU thing. :laughing: Also down for Smash. What rulesets? Competitive or fun items-on?

nico: Thinking fun pools first (items on, random stages) then a losers-bracket competitive best-of-3 for folks who want it. No harsh seeding.

lobbybot: Reminder: rooftop events must be registered with ops. Filing quick form now...

nico: Thanks bot. Ops form note: "estimated 12 people, low noise, food included". If ops responds with a time window we'll post here.

anya: Can someone bring a multi-outlet surge? My PSU pouch is tiny.

derek: I got two power strips + a phone charger hub.

marcos: Question: anyone streaming? I can clip if we have a capture. Otherwise Ill take photos.

nico: If someone can stream, we can toss highlights to the socials account. No one has to be on camera without consent.

anya: Quick PSA for consoles: label controllers with masking tape and initials. Saved me last time.

marcos: Also, ping me if you need adaptors for older HDMI -> mini. I have a box.

lobbybot: Ops cleared rooftop 3-9pm slot. Please keep music <70dB after 8pm.

nico: Score. Plan: show up around 3:30 for setup. Well run a simple sign-up sheet at arrival. Potluck snacks welcome.

derek: Tiny tech tip for PC-to-PC file sharing for custom maps: if someone runs into firewall issues, quick command on Windows to check a machine IP: 
```
ipconfig | findstr /R "IPv4"
```

anya: Ill bring a stack of spare ethernet cables and a little gig switch.

marcos: Poll time: React with emoji for which mode you want first: :smash: Smash, :kart: Mario Kart, :retro: Emulation hour, :party: Party games

nico: :smash:

anya: :retro:

marcos: :kart:

derek: :party:

lobbybot: Poll tally 13 Smash 1, Mario Kart 1, Retro 1, Party games 1

nico: Nice spread. One more note: bring ID for lobby, and if youre bringing big monitors mark "fragile". See you Sunday!
